why: Both land on a bank/financial automation hedgehog, the stop-fighting-Rival-I call and all three key brutal facts, but Analysis 2 sits closer to the key by including accounting users and a profit-per-installed-account denominator. Analysis 2 also names the one-forceful-executive dependence more sharply ("genius with a thousand helpers", named successors, endurance beyond the EVP) and is more candid about the method's limits, though neither warns about cost cuts starving engineering and service.
